verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an AI Editor that creates and modifies ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts. That is a first-party natural-language capability, but it covers only one narrow area rather than general operation of the product. Missing for 10: natural-language control across the platform (controls, risks, audits, vendors, policies), a conversational assistant or command interface, documentation of supported commands and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
